text: The Blue Tent stole this one by 1.43 in an upset. Down 3.67 after Sunday night, they flipped it on Monday while the Seattle Seahawks defense posted -0.4 for the other side. Jacoby Brissett, a recent add, gave them 4.46 at quarterback on an 18.33 projection. Drake London blew it for London Cooking and is now listed Questionable. Christian Watson was hurt in the 2nd quarter and James Cook III in the 4th; both, plus Michael Wilson, are now listed Questionable. This week the winners' playoff odds climbed to 75%, while the losers slid to 4th.
